limitations: The final COMP.FUNDA construction yields 50,520 firm-years, 8,258 firms, and 44 industries, versus 21,758, 4,252, and 36 reported in the paper. There are 52,535 Appendix-complete rows before the 15-observation group cutoff and 544 qualifying industry-years versus 416 in the paper; no specific cause of the excess is confirmed, and historical cohort coverage is unverified.
Table 4 leaves the annual cross-sectional estimator and Newey-West bandwidth unspecified. The implementation uses annual OLS cross-sections and Newey-West lag 1 as documented best-effort choices.
Equation (5) and Appendix A use lagged sales for normal discretionary expenses, while the Table 2 note prints contemporaneous sales; the implementation follows Equation (5) and Appendix A.

The 1987 sample has 296 observations after industry-years with fewer than 15 observations are removed. Of 554 Appendix-complete rows, 296 lie in 10 qualifying industry-years; omitting the t-2 sales requirement adds 9 rows. A completeness diagnostic omitting CFO-related fields yields 3,432 rows, indicating that local data availability contributes to the low 1987 count.

The historical-price audit leaves 2,412 of 130,164 nonmissing annual PRCC_F endpoints without a supported currency route. These prices remain unavailable for price-based measures. Short daily fallback quotes are accepted only within three calendar days, when CRSP.DSI shows zero intervening market sessions and daily PRCCD matches annual PRCC_F; the local daily source has no security-specific suspension field, so the market-session check is a conservative approximation. The verified monthly or daily quote date supplies the daily FX join for price translation.
